text:
mira.docs: Quick pass on the 'hello-mini' quickstart before the onboarding sprint. Found a few small but high-friction issues we should fix together: wrong auth header in the raw fetch example, Windows PowerShell env instructions missing, Dockerfile pins SDK v1, and the inline playground snippet still uses the old method name.
jon.eng: Can you paste the offending fetch snippet?
mira.docs: Sure — current snippet in step 2:
```js
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { Authorization: `Basic ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'Hello' })
})
```
This will confuse folks. Should be Bearer and ideally we point beginners to the SDK one-liner instead of raw fetch.
tara.devex: Also noticed the quickstart only shows `export REDWOOD_API_TOKEN=...`. For workshops we need a PowerShell example: `$env:REDWOOD_API_TOKEN = '...'` and a note that it only lasts for that session.
sam.qa: I ran into the Docker issue — examples/docker/Dockerfile still does `RUN npm i @redwood/inference@^1`. That breaks copy-paste for new users. Bumping to `^2` and updating imports should be safe.
jon.eng: Thanks. Plan: I will open a small docs PR to: 1) change fetch header to Bearer and swap the primary snippet to the SDK one-liner (keeps novices on the right path), 2) add a PowerShell env block and a one-line note about demo tokens expiring in 24h, 3) update Dockerfile to `@redwood/inference@^2` and simplify imports to `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'`, 4) change sample call from `generate()` -> `createCompletion()` and fix response access to `res.output[0].text`.
mira.docs: Can you also add a short migration note at the top of the quickstart: "Upgrading from SDK v1: method and response changes; see migration guide (link)" so search finds it.
jon.eng: Yep, I'll add a one-line callout and link to /docs/upgrading-sdk. Also will add a tiny TS test snippet showing how to stub a token for unit tests (`new RedwoodClient({ token: 'test' })`) so maintainers can copy into CI mocks.
tara.devex: Tiny UX request: keep the raw-fetch example for advanced users but mark it "Advanced: raw HTTP" and explicitly show the Bearer header. That way the quickstart remains approachable.
merge-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1720 "fix(quickstart): auth header, powershell env, docker sdk bump, method rename" by jon.eng
sam.qa: I'll run a cross-platform playground smoke after the PR lands (copy button regression in the past). I'll check Node 18/20 and Windows runners.
mira.docs: Please also bump the quickstart's metadata version so the site cache invalidates — small but necessary for workshop instructors who pull cached pages.
jon.eng: Good call, will increment doc meta 'version: 1.3.1' in the frontmatter.
sam.qa: CI started: docs build + link-checker. If everything is green I'll merge and then run the playground smoke.
merge-bot: CI passed (docs build). Ready to merge.
jon.eng: Merged. I also created a tiny follow-up issue to restore a legacy compatibility snippet for internal repos that still reference `generate()` (tracking issue #2042).
mira.docs: Amazing, thanks team. After merge I'll update the onboarding checklist and post a one-line note in #help for instructors to pull latest before the upcoming cohort. :thumbsup:
